scope: Selected-sample critical-claim review, not exhaustive. US macro and curve; China macro/activity/credit/property; Poland macro, markets, fiscal, corporate and security; XLK/XLC/XLF/XLE Reported; retail lead Drivers and Social Signal. Canonical publisher-URL date audit is separate.

checks.result: Core inflation/PCE and legal-event prose stays within headline claims. Friday completed events precede Monday cutoff; Treasury levels, 20-observation changes, spread and regime wording match own card.

Official August manufacturing contraction is Sunday news before Monday cutoff; no report-day private PMI actual imported. July activity, lending and property references are older monthly observations and preceded cutoff. Markets match own card and periods.

RPP is treated as pending, inflation below 3% and budget deficit match cited titles; corporate and defence claims are bounded by their titles. Price/return sample matches own card, including Dino current share units.
MongoDB and Dell reaction, spectrum transaction, capital-regulation remark and Rosneft income direction match headlines. No unsupported numerical earnings detail or same-day outcome in sample.

OPEN close, 1s/5s changes, prior reference, Russell return and Treasury observations match card. Social paragraph uses actual meme-stock framing; no invented posts, flow quantities or platform counts.

limitations: Selected sample only; other sections and individual citations remain outside this review.
Canonical publisher publication timestamps were not independently fetched; parent handles that audit.
